summary: Pick one subplan (prose, poetry, or fiction into film) and complete at least 26 units in it. Every course must be taken for a letter grade with a C- or better, and every workshop for 5 units; the short story course, ENGLISH 160 and the English literature elective may be 3 to 5 units. The literature elective is any ENGLISH course that is not a creative writing workshop, and the audit cannot tell lectures from workshops beyond the workshops this minor lists. A course substitution (at most two) or transfer course (transfer students only, at most three) is approved by the program and moved in by hand.

program.why: Grading: "a student must take the course for a letter grade only and must receive a passing grade. A passing grade for all Creative Writing minor requirements is a “C-” or better."
